ValidationRule.description: Closed cases can't be reopened on or before 30-Aug (QAC go-live)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - Freight', $Profile.Name <> 'Qantas System Admin - QCC', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'QAC API Integration Profile', RecordType.Name == 'Service Request', IsClosed=true,ISCHANGED(Status),ISPICKVAL(Status,'Reopened'),DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) < DATEVALUE('2018-08-30') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot Reopen the Service Request cases which are closed before 30-Aug-2018
